title: Privacy Policy & Data Handling
lead: Green Gate Advisory is committed to handling professional enquiries with confidentiality, transparency, and compliance with applicable data protection legislation.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you submit a consultation enquiry, we collect the details you provide: full name, organisation, work email, country/region, professional role, service interest, and requirement details. We process this information solely to evaluate your advisory requirements and respond to your enquiry.

sections.title: Legal Basis & Purpose of Processing
sections.body: Data is processed on the basis of legitimate interest in responding to commercial enquiries and preliminary advisory requests initiated by you. We do not sell, rent, or distribute contact lists to third-party commercial brokers.

sections.title: Data Retention & Security
sections.body: We apply technical measures to safeguard submissions. Information is retained only as long as necessary to fulfill the initial advisory dialogue or comply with applicable legal recordkeeping rules.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to request access to, rectification of, or erasure of your personal details at any time by contacting our privacy team at privacy@greengateadvisory.com.
